==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|breefly}}, {{m|enm|breffly}}, {{m|enm|brevely}}, {{m|enm|brevelike}}, {{m|enm|breveliche}}, equivalent to {{af|en|brief|-ly|id2=adverbial}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈbɹiːfli/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-briefly.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|iːfli|s=2}}

===Adverb===
{{en-adv}}

# {{lb|en|manner}} In a [[brief]] manner, [[summarily]].
#: {{ux|en|He covered the subject '''briefly''' in his book.}}
# {{lb|en|duration}} For a brief period.
#: {{ux|en|He only worked here '''briefly'''.}}
#* {{RQ:en:New York Times|author=Maya Salam|title=‘Squid Game: The Challenge’: Hits, Misses and the Bizarre Ending|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2023/12/07/arts/television/squid-game-the-challenge-season-1-finale.html|date=2023-12-07|passage=Instead, ddakji was played for dramatic effect earlier in the season — pitting two men who had forged a sweet bond against each other, making one of them '''briefly''' believe he’d been eliminated by his friend.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20231208025933/https://www.nytimes.com/2023/12/07/arts/television/squid-game-the-challenge-season-1-finale.html}}
# To be brief, [[in short]].
#: {{ux|en|'''Briefly''', I am not happy about what happened, but no one will be losing their job.}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|in a brief manner}} in [[summarization]], [[concisely]], [[in short]], [[in a word]], to [[sum up]]
* {{sense|for a brief period}} {{l|en|fleetingly}}, {{l|en|summarily}}, {{l|en|temporarily}}, {{l|en|transiently}}; see also [[Thesaurus:temporarily]]
